Subject: Promo exception request: Zephyr Robotics - combined credits + discount for pilot

Team —

Quick ask: Zephyr Robotics (autonomous inspection for industrial sites) is asking for a combined promotional exception to land a 3-month pilot this quarter. They’re an excellent strategic fit (edge robotics partner, potential marketplace referral path) and Legal/Procurement have indicated they can move quickly if we can finalize commercial terms this week.

What I’m requesting: exec-level approval to offer the following one-time exception:
- $40,000 free Redwood credits applied to the account upon SOW signature (to cover inference consumption during pilot)
- 45% off list hosted API usage for the first 3 months of the pilot (to reduce friction while they iterate)
- 30-day trial extension beyond our standard 14-day trial window (pilot runs are time-sensitive for them)

Business rationale: Zephyr has ~120 field sites and a head of platform (Ava Turner) who made this a priority; they’ve budgeted for a production roll after PoC if the pilot shows <2s tail latency and cost-per-inspection at or below $0.12. Expected ARR if converted: ~$1.1M–1.5M over 24 months. This is also a strong integration reference for our edge batch-serving improvements.

Constraints & asks:
- We should require a signed SOW before credits are applied.
- Prefer to gate the discount to the first 3 months only and then revert to standard pricing unless we secure a committed reserved capacity (Dedicated) commit.
- Finance will need a single-line justification for the credit write-off.

Attachments: Zephyr_Mutual_Action_Plan.pdf (attached), draft SOW (Zephyr_SOW-draft.docx). HubSpot deal: ZPH-4721.

Request: marissa / vivek — is there executive approval to proceed with the combined package? If yes, any adjustments (credit amount / discount %) you’d like to make? I’m happy to present a one-line commercial justification for Finance.

Thanks —
Rishi

Rishi —

Thanks for the write-up. I’m comfortable approving a promo exception to get the pilot signed quickly, with the following conditions:
- Limit the discount window to the first 3 months only (no ongoing list change without a committed Reserved capacity).
- Credits applied on SOW signature and tracked as a marketing/sales credit line.
- Finance needs a short justification (I’ll draft a one-liner once you confirm exact numbers).

That said, 45% is steeper than my preference for a first pilot; can we consider 40% instead and keep the $40k credits? If Zephyr pushes back, we can escalate. If Rishi is fine, I’ll route to Finance for the write-off.

Approve-in-principle pending final alignment on discount vs credits.
